content_blocks.title: The central idea
content_blocks.text: Language models estimate or generate token sequences from learned patterns and context. Textual fluency is not the same as factual grounding, and model behavior varies with context, training data, and evaluation method.

content_blocks.title: Syllabus topics covered in this lesson

items.title: Statistical language models
items.text: A language model estimates token sequences from context and can generate text conditioned on a prompt. Its learned patterns do not guarantee factual recall, source awareness, or correct tool use.

items.title: Word embeddings
items.text: An embedding maps an item such as a word, passage, image, or user into a vector. Similarity is meaningful only relative to the model, data, distance metric, and intended retrieval task.
